entities.name: Foresters Life Insurance Company
entities.description: Named on the page as one of IOF's subsidiaries: '... trade names and trademarks of The Independent Order of Foresters ... and its subsidiaries, including Foresters Life Insurance Company.' The Financial strength page adds: 'In 2025, A.M. Best also assigned IOF's subsidiary Foresters Life Insurance Company (FLIC) an A (Excellent) Financial Strength Rating.'

operating_entities.note: foresters.com has no 'our companies' / legal-entities page. The only own-site entity disclosure is the trademark/underwriter footer on the Legal page (repeated on every page) and the Financial strength page (https://www.foresters.com/en-ca/about-us/financial-strength), which names IOF and its subsidiary FLIC. The US financial-strength page refers to 'the US branch of the Independent Order of Foresters' (a branch, not a separate entity). Canada Protection Plan Inc., FLIAC (sold 2020), Foresters Asset Management (sold 2019) and the UK friendly society are NOT named on these pages and are therefore not listed. No general-account manager is named on the site; the OSFI Climate Risk Management Report 2025 (https://www.foresters.com/-/media/foresters/documents/pdfs/en-ca/osfi-climate-risk-management-report-2025-en-ca.pdf) says 'The Investments team surveys our asset managers annually on ESG', and AM Best (Oct 2025) states 'investments 100% externally managed'; external managers are not named.

cio.note: Designated as the most senior investment officer because his company bio states he is 'responsible for the Global Financial, Investment, Actuarial, Asset Liability Management, Capital management and business planning functions'. AM Best's Oct 2025 officer list still shows 'Chief Investment Officer, Vice President: Clark D. Wagner (Investments)', but public career data (MarketScreener) end Wagner's CIO role on 2019-11-05 when the US asset manager was sold to Macquarie, and foresters.com lists no CIO; treat Wagner as stale. The general account is 100% externally managed (AM Best Oct 2025); an internal 'Investments team' oversees the external asset managers (OSFI Climate Risk Management Report 2025). industry_since null: start of career not given in any source.

notes: Two legal entities: FLIC (OSFI id 28432; the Canadian stock subsidiary) and parent IOF (fraternal; US branch and Canada; UK via a subsidiary). The executive team is global, so FLIC has no separate CEO/CFO/CIO. Investment construct: fully outsourced since the 2019 sale of Foresters Asset Management (to Fiera Capital) and First Investors/FIMCO (to Macquarie); Board Risk and Investment Committee approves the Investment Policy; the Global CFO owns Investment and ALM. Canada Protection Plan (canada_protection_plan.json) is a distribution brand/subsidiary whose policies are underwritten by FLIC/IOF; its CIO section points here.
